name: kmcheck
description: Sistema de diagnóstico y mantenimiento vehicular (React + Express + Cloudflare Workers)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared --noEmit && tsc -p backend --noEmit && tsc -p frontend --noEmit
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build && npm run audit:security
